price.metaTitle: Enterprise Research at Startup Prices | Frank
price.metaDescription: Forget $500–$1,000 interviews, endless moderation, and weeks of waiting. With Frank, you get deep, qualitative insight at a fraction of the cost and scale your learning without scaling your budget.

hero.label: Price
hero.p: Forget $500–$1,000 interviews, endless moderation, and weeks of waiting. With Frank, you get deep, qualitative insight at a fraction of the cost and scale your learning without scaling your budget.

items.title: Enterprise-grade customer research with startup pricing
items.text: Traditional moderated interviews can cost anywhere from $100 to $1,000+ per participant. With Frank, cost-per-interview drops so low that you can run dozens or hundreds of interviews for the price of a single agency session.

items.title: No moderators. No scheduling. No overhead.
items.text: Forget recruiting, coordination, calendar management, prep calls, and moderation time. Your AI Interviewer handles 100s of simultaneous conversations around the world automatically without adding a single hour to your team’s workload.

items.title: Unlimited iteration. Same budget.
items.text: When resources are low, research and learning are always the first to go… But now you can run follow-ups, re-test features, validate revisions, and explore new ideas without ever worrying about hourly rates or billable time, even on a shoestring budget!

items.title: Predictable pricing. Zero surprises.
items.text: No hidden fees. No extra charges for transcripts, analysis, or reporting. You pay only for what you need, and can always purchase additional credits to run additional interviews as needed. Everything — interviews, analysis, tagging, summaries is included.

cards.title: Research you can actually afford to do every week
cards.text: Most teams want to talk to customers. They just can’t justify the cost. Frank makes continuous qualitative research financially realistic, even for small teams.

cards.title: More data for the same budget
cards.text: Keep doing what you’re doing, but better! With the same spend, you’ll soon be having 50-100× more conversations. Meaning stronger signals, clearer patterns, and more confident decisions.

cards.title: Reduced time cost for your team
cards.text: What used to take days of preparation, interviewing, and follow-up now takes… minutes. Your team stays focused on building while Frank does the heavy lifting.

cards.title: Free your budget for development, marketing, and growth
cards.text: When your research costs shrink, you can reallocate the budget where it drives revenue without sacrificing insight.

testimonial.intro: From startups to scale-ups, teams rely on Frank to replace weeks of research with clear, actionable insights in hours.
quote: Qualitative research used to be one of the hardest things.
With Frank’s AI Researcher the trade-off is gone. We can now access global users without worrying about scheduling, availability, or high agency costs.

cta.sub: And do it without scaling your team.

quality.metaTitle: Customer Insights You Can Actually Trust | Frank
quality.metaDescription: Manual interviews vary — moderators differ and analysis is subjective. With Frank, every interview produces consistent, structured insights you can trust for real decisions.

hero.label: Quality
hero.p: Manual interviews vary — moderators differ and analysis is subjective. With Frank, every interview produces consistent, structured insights you can trust for real decisions.

items.title: Rigorous, structured interviewing. Every. Single. Time.
items.text: Human interviews vary in skill, energy, and depth. Especially when run by non-professional researchers. Frank follows a consistent, proven qualitative framework — probing deeply, asking smart follow-ups, and never leading the participant.

items.title: Verifiable & referenced insights
items.text: Every insight comes with the evidence behind it. Timestamped quotes, conversation threads, themes, underlying patterns… Nothing is hand-waved. And you can always trace every insight and conclusion back to real customer words.

items.title: Qualitative depth at survey scale
items.text: One interview shows a feeling. A hundred interviews show a fact. Frank aggregates individual conversations into repeatable, cross-validated insight, revealing the patterns behind the stories. All with survey-scale sample sizes that traditional qual can’t touch.

items.title: Instant, consistent analysis with zero human bias
items.text: Have you ever tuned out during an interview? Get distracted by a notification? Lead an answer based on your bias? Frank doesn’t get tired, isn’t selective, has no bias. And it always does everything with the same level of rigor whether you run 5 interviews or 500.

cards.title: Confidence in the decisions you make
cards.text: Your recommendations aren’t based on guesses or a handful of conversations — they’re backed by deep, consistent evidence.

cards.title: Know where your insights come from
cards.text: Leadership wants to know why customers churned and the data behind it. With Frank, every insight is backed by the conversation it came from.

cards.title: Reliable quantifiable signals. Not noisy opinions.
cards.text: Frank turns qualitative interviews into clear, quantifiable signals validated across many participants — not just one opinion.

cards.title: Alignment across teams without debate
cards.text: Traceable evidence helps teams align faster. Frank turns data into clear insights and next steps — no more debating opinions.

scale.metaDescription: Talk to 10, 100, or even 1,000+ customers at once without adding headcount, extra hours, or operational overhead.

hero.label: Scale
hero.p: Talk to 10, 100, or even 1,000+ customers at once without adding headcount, extra hours, or operational overhead.

items.title: Unlimited interview capacity
items.text: Interview 1 user or 10,000 without any increase in effort on your part. Frank runs conversations in parallel, 24/7, across markets, segments, and time zones. So your research time is never a bottleneck in the sprint.

items.title: Massive qualitative data. Zero operational load
items.text: No interviewer training. No panel management. No scheduling chaos. Our AI Research Assistant guides you through the process of setting research goals and building your interview outline. All you have to do is share the link!

items.title: Global access in 30+ languages
items.text: Move beyond your home market instantly. Talk to customers in any region or language and query the insights in your own language, getting actionable next steps you can work on immediately, no matter the market.

items.title: Scale depth. Not just volume
items.text: Imagine being able to get survey-scale qualitative data. Every response is automatically tagged, clustered, analyzed, and connected. So you’re no longer looking at one-off qualitative insights, you can find patterns and quantify the reach of your insights.

cards.title: Bigger samples. Stronger confidence
cards.text: One enthusiastic early adopter is an anecdote, but one thousand aligned interviews are evidence.

cards.title: Faster market validation
cards.text: Not sure if demand exists? Launch interviews across segments and countries and see patterns emerge within hours, not quarters.

cards.title: Expansion without expanding your team
cards.text: You don’t need more researchers to uncover more insights. You simply need a research system that scales for you.

cards.title: Build products for real markets. Not small samples.
cards.text: When you scale customer understanding, decisions stop being guesses. You get clarity grounded in real behavior across a meaningful sample size.
